title: Windows brings out the Rorschach test in everyone
summary: Raymond Chen's classic blog post from 2003 exploring how different people interpret Windows behaviors and messages in vastly different ways, much like a Rorschach inkblot test where the same input produces wildly different perceived meanings.
problem_solved: Explains why users, developers, and testers often have conflicting interpretations of the same Windows system behavior or error message.
why_valuable: Provides insight into the human and psychological factors behind software design challenges, helping developers understand why consistent UI/UX communication matters.
